name: Production experience pack preserves the complete conversion journey
description: A reviewed production pack presents a viewport-safe opening, the required navigation and content, a working FAQ, and an honest lead-form outcome.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the production experience-pack gallery
Verify the header exposes Services, FAQs, and Contact and the complete hero is visible without horizontal clipping
Verify an interactive conversion form appears immediately after the hero
Navigate to Services and open one service detail page
Verify the service page contains useful decision support, related services, FAQs, and a contact action
Return to the homepage, navigate to FAQs, and expand one question
Verify the answer is visible and readable
Navigate to Contact, complete the lead form with fictional valid details, and submit it
Verify the page shows an honest not-configured fallback and does not claim the message was sent
